blocks.text: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) ke kai bunyadi concepts hain jo programs ko munazzam (organized), dobara istemal ke qabil (reusable) aur sambhalne mein aasan banate hain. Yeh concepts hain: classes aur objects, encapsulation, inheritance aur polymorphism.

blocks.title: Do You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Class aik blueprint (naqsha) ki tarah hai, aur object woh asal cheez hai jo us naqshe se banti hai.
Classes aur Objects: asal duniya ki cheezein code mein

Class aik blueprint ya template (saancha) hai jo kisi cheez (entity) ki properties (attributes) aur kaam (methods) tay karti hai. Object class ka aik instance (namoona) hai jis ke attributes ki asal values hoti hain (Figure 3.1 dekhein). Classes aur objects ki madad se programmer asal duniya ki cheezon ka code mein model banata hai. Is se data aur us se jura kaam (functionality) aik jagah ikattha rehta hai aur program zyada munazzam ho jata hai.

blocks.alt: Class aur object ka khaaka: Class: Person ke dabbe mein Attributes (name, age, gender) aur Methods (eat(), sleep(), work()) likhe hain, saath insaan ka saaya. Teer Object P1 (name = Bob, age = 34, gender = Male) aur Object P2 (name = Jenny, age = 27, gender = Female) tak jate hain; dono mein wohi teen methods hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.1: Class aur Object ka rishta (kitab ki Figure 3.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Misal (Example):

class Student:
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name

    def display(self):
        print("Student Name:", self.name)

# Creating objects
object1 = Student("Ali")
object2 = Student("Ahmed")

# Using objects
object1.display()
object2.display()

Student Name: Ali
Student Name: Ahmed
blocks.caption: Output (program chala kar)

items: class Student → students ka blueprint (naqsha) banati hai.
__init__ → object bante hi khud chalta hai aur naam set karta hai (yeh constructor hai).
self.name → har student ka naam rakhta hai; self khud us object ki taraf ishara hai.
display() → student ka naam print karta hai.
object1 aur object2 → do alag Student objects.
Har object ka apna data hai (Ali, Ahmed).

blocks.text: Encapsulation

Encapsulation OOP ka woh concept hai jis mein data (variables) aur methods (functions) ko aik unit, yani class, mein band kar diya jata hai aur data tak seedhi pohanch (direct access) rok di jati hai.

Java ya C++ jaisi languages ki tarah Python mein "private" ya "protected" jaise sakht keywords nahi hain. Python naam rakhne ke tareeqe (naming conventions) se batata hai ke data ko kaise istemal karna chahiye.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: Data ko chhupayein aur us tak pohanch sirf methods ke zariye dein.
Encapsulation kyun zaroori hai

items: Data ko ghair zaroori pohanch se bachati hai.
Security (hifazat) behtar karti hai.
Code sambhalna aasan banati hai.
Sirf qaboo mein rakhi hui (controlled) tabdeeli ki ijazat deti hai.

blocks.text: Misal (Example):
Bank account ka sochein:
Aap ka balance chhupa hua hai.
Aap us tak sirf in ke zariye pohanch sakte hain:

items: deposit() (paise jama karna)
withdraw() (paise nikalna)

blocks.text: Aap balance ko seedha nahi badal sakte; yahi encapsulation hai.
1. Access control ke darje (levels)
Python mein class ke members (variables aur methods) kahan se nazar aayein, yeh naam ke shuru mein khaas nishan (prefix) laga kar tay kiya jata hai:

items: Public Members: yeh har jagah se, class ke andar ya bahar, istemal ho sakte hain. Python mein aam taur par (by default) sab members public hote hain (Figure 3.2). Syntax: self.attribute_name

Protected Members: yeh class aur us ki subclasses ke andar istemal ke liye hain. Yeh sirf aik riwaj (convention) hai, pabandi nahi: doosre programmers ko ishara hai ke is member ko bahar se istemal na karein. Syntax: self._attribute_name (aik underscore)

Private Members: yeh bohat mehdood (restricted) hain aur class ke bahar se aasani se istemal nahi ho sakte. Python Name Mangling naam ka tareeqa use karta hai jo variable ka andar ka naam badal deta hai taake ghalti se pohanch na ho. Syntax: self.__attribute_name (do underscores)

blocks.alt: Encapsulation ka khaaka: User / Outside Class se sabz teer (tick, Access allowed) Class Object ke andar Public Methods / Interface (getValue(), setValue()) tak jata hai; methods se nuqta-daar teer Private Data (__private_variable) tak. User se private data tak laal tooti lakeer par cross aur Direct access restricted likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.2: Private aur public variables dikhane wala encapsulation khaaka (kitab ki Figure 3.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 3.2 mein Private Data ke andar '_private_variable' aik underscore ke saath chhapa hai. Python mein aik underscore (_name) protected ka riwaj hai; private member do underscores (__name) se banta hai, jaise kitab ki table bhi batati hai. Is liye yahan '__private_variable' likha gaya hai. Bahar wala code sirf public methods (getValue(), setValue()) se data tak pohanchta hai; seedhi rasai (direct access) band hai.
Misal (Example):

Balance 1000 se shuru hota hai; 500 jama karne se 1500 aur 300 nikalne se 1200 reh jata hai, is liye output 1200 hai. Aakhri line (jo comment mein hai) chalayein to account.__balance par AttributeError aata hai, kyunke name mangling ne class ke andar variable ka naam badal diya hai.
Inheritance: functionality ko dobara istemal karna aur barhana

Inheritance aik class ko doosri class ki properties aur methods lene deti hai. Nayi class, jise subclass kehte hain, parent class ki khusoosiyat mein izafa ya tabdeeli kar sakti hai. Inheritance code ke dobara istemal (reuse) ko barhati aur aik hi code ki takrar (redundancy) kam karti hai. Is se maujooda code dobara likhe baghair program ko barhana aasan ho jata hai.
Inheritance ki yeh qismein hain:

Single Inheritance: jab child class (subclass) sirf aik parent class (superclass) se attributes aur methods leti hai. Yeh Python mein inheritance ki sab se bunyadi shakal hai; child class parent ke behaviour ko barha ya badal sakti hai, is se code dobara istemal hota hai (Figure 3.3).

blocks.alt: Single inheritance: Child Class ka dabba Parent Class ke neeche hai; dono aik lakeer se jure hain jis ka khokhla (hollow) teer ka sira Parent Class par hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.3: Single Inheritance (kitab ki Figure 3.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teer child class se parent class ki taraf jata hai aur us ka khokhla (hollow) sira parent par hai. Matlab: child parent se inherit karti hai, yani parent ke attributes aur methods le leti hai. Neeche wali misal mein Animal parent hai aur Dog child.
Misal (Example):
Is misal mein Dog class Animal ki bunyadi functionality le leti hai aur apna khaas kaam bhi shamil karti hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit (dilchasp baat)
blocks.text: self maujooda object ka hawala (reference) hai; Python ise instance methods ko khud bhejta hai.

items: Parent Class (Base Class): woh class jis ki properties inherit hoti hain. Oopar wali misal mein Animal parent class hai.
Child Class (Derived Class): woh class jo parent se inherit karti hai. Is ko banate waqt parent ka naam brackets mein likha jata hai: class Child(Parent):.
Method Overriding: child class parent mein pehle se maujood method ka apna version de sakti hai. Parent wala version call karne ke liye super() function istemal hota hai.

blocks.text: Izafi misal (kitab mein nahi): super() ke saath overriding. Puppy class Dog se inherit karti hai, apna eat() deti hai aur us ke andar super().eat() se pehle parent ka eat() chalati hai.

blocks.caption: Izafi misal: super() ke saath method overriding

blocks.text:
Moti is eating.
Moti wants more milk.
blocks.caption: Output

blocks.text: Multiple Inheritance: Python mein aik class aik se zyada parent classes se features (attributes aur methods) le sakti hai. Is tarah child class mukhtalif jagahon ka behaviour mila leti hai, maslan Smartphone class jo Camera aur Computer dono classes se inherit kare (Figure 3.4).

blocks.alt: Multiple inheritance: Child Class ke oopar do dabbe, Parent Class 1 aur Parent Class 2; child se dono parents tak lakeerein, har aik ke sire par parent ki taraf khokhla teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.4: Multiple Inheritance (kitab ki Figure 3.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Misal (Example):
Is misal mein Child class Father aur Mother dono classes se inherit karti hai, is liye dono parents ke methods istemal kar sakti hai.

Father's skill: Gardening
Mother's skill: Cooking
Child's skill: Coding
blocks.caption: Output (program chala kar)

blocks.text: Multilevel Inheritance: jab aik class aisi class se inherit kare jo khud kisi aur se derived (bani hui) hai, to khandani shajre (family tree) jaisi zanjeer banti hai (Grandparent → Parent → Child). Is mein "grandchild" class apne parent aur grandparent dono ke tamam methods aur attributes istemal kar sakti hai (Figure 3.5). (Kitab mein 'derived' ki jagah 'drived' chhapa hai; yeh spelling ki chhoti ghalti hai.)

blocks.alt: Multilevel inheritance: teen dabbe aik column mein: oopar Grand Parent Class, beech mein Parent Class, neeche Child Class; har neeche wali class oopar wali se khokhle teer wali lakeer se juri hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.5: Multilevel Inheritance (kitab ki Figure 3.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Misal (Example):
Is misal mein ElectricCar, Car se inherit karti hai, aur Car khud Vehicle se inherit karti hai.

Engine started.
Car is driving.
Battery is charging.
blocks.caption: Output (program chala kar)

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Aik Vehicle class banayein aur us se Car aur Bike subclasses banayein. Har subclass mein apna alag method dalein aur inheritance chala kar dikhayein.
Polymorphism

Polymorphism ka matlab hai "kai shaklein" (many forms). Yani koi cheez (jaise function ya object) halaat (context) ke mutabiq mukhtalif kaam kar sakti hai. Takneeki taur par polymorphism aik hi method, function ya operator ko us object ke mutabiq mukhtalif behaviour dene deta hai jis par woh kaam kar raha ho. Is se code zyada lachakdar (flexible) aur dobara istemal ke qabil banta hai.

Misal: aik backend payment system mein payment ke kai tareeqe hain, jaise Credit Card, UPI (fauri bank transfer service; Pakistan mein is jaisi service Raast hai), NetBanking aur Wallet. Sab ek hi naam ka method processPayment() istemal karte hain, lekin har aik ka kaam (implementation) alag hai:

items: NetBanking Payment: user ko bank ke login page par le jati hai.

blocks.text: Method ka naam wahi rehta hai, lekin kaam payment ki qism ke mutabiq badal jata hai. (Kitab sirf NetBanking ka kaam batati hai; neeche wali izafi misal do qismon ko code mein dikhati hai.)

blocks.caption: Izafi misal (kitab mein nahi): aik method ka naam, mukhtalif payment ka kaam

blocks.text:
Charging card: 500
Redirecting to bank login for 500
blocks.caption: Output

blocks.text: Polymorphism ki qismein
Polymorphism ka matlab hai ke aik hi method ya operation object ya halaat ke mutabiq mukhtalif behaviour kare. Is ki do bari qismein hain: compile-time aur runtime polymorphism (Figure 3.6).

blocks.alt: Polymorphism ka shajra: Polymorphism se do shakhein: Compile-time Polymorphism jo Method Overloading tak jati hai, aur Runtime Polymorphism jo Method Overriding tak jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.6: Aik hi function ka mukhtalif bartao, polymorphism ki misal (kitab ki Figure 3.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: 1. Compile-time Polymorphism

Compile-time polymorphism mein yeh faisla ke kaun sa method ya operation chalega, compilation ke dauran hota hai, aam taur par method ya operator overloading se. Java aur C++ yeh dete hain. Lekin Python statically typed languages (Java, C++) ki tarah function signature ki bunyad par asli method overloading nahi deta. Python dynamically typed hai, is liye aik hi function mukhtalif qism ke arguments le sakta hai aur signature wali overloading ki zaroorat nahi rehti. Is ke bajaye default arguments, variable-length arguments (*args, **kwargs) ya function ke andar shart (conditional logic) laga kar milta julta behaviour hasil kiya jata hai.

Misal: yeh code default aur variable-length arguments se method overloading dikhata hai. multiply() method mukhtalif tadaad ke inputs ke saath kaam karta hai aur compile-time polymorphism ki naqal karta hai.

class Calculator:
    def multiply(self, a=1, b=1, *args):
        result = a * b
        for num in args:
            result *= num
        return result

# Create object
calc = Calculator()

# Using default arguments
print(calc.multiply())
print(calc.multiply(4))

# Using multiple arguments
print(calc.multiply(2, 3))
print(calc.multiply(2, 3, 4))
multiply() mein a aur b ki default value 1 hai: koi argument na ho to 1 × 1 = 1; sirf 4 ho to 4 × 1 = 4; 2 aur 3 se 6; aur 2, 3, 4 mein 4 *args mein jata hai, is liye 2 × 3 × 4 = 24.
2. Runtime Polymorphism (Overriding)

Runtime polymorphism mein method ka behaviour program chalte waqt tay hota hai, is bunyad par ke method kis object ne call kiya. Yeh Method Overriding se hota hai: child class parent mein pehle se maujood method ka apna version deti hai.

Misal: yeh code method overriding se runtime polymorphism dikhata hai. sound() method base class Animal mein bana hai aur Dog aur Cat mein override hua hai. Program chalte waqt object ki class ke mutabiq sahi method chalta hai.

Bark
Meow
Some generic sound
blocks.caption: Output

blocks.text: Yahan sound method ka behaviour is baat par munhasir hai ke object Dog hai, Cat hai ya Animal, aur yeh faisla runtime par hota hai. Yahi dynamic tabiyat Python ko runtime polymorphism ke liye khaas taur par taqatwar banati hai.

blocks.prompt: Python class mein __init__ ka maqsad kya hai?
blocks.explanation: __init__ constructor hai. Yeh object bante hi khud chalta aur object ke ibtidai attributes, jaise self.name = name, set karta hai.

blocks.prompt: BankAccount class mein agar balance 1200 ho aur program account.withdraw(2000) call kare to kya hoga? Yeh encapsulation ki misal kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh 'Insufficient balance' print karega aur balance 1200 rahega. Private balance sirf un methods se badalta hai jo request jaanchte hain, is liye ghalat tabdeeli ruk jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Inheritance, encapsulation aur polymorphism mil kar behtar software design kaise dete hain?
blocks.explanation: Encapsulation har class ka data mehfooz aur interface wazeh rakhti hai; inheritance code copy karne ke bajaye jaanchi parkhi classes dobara use aur wasee karti hai; polymorphism aik code ko bohat si mutalliq classes ke saath chalne deti hai. Nateeja modular code hai jise barhana, test karna aur sambhalna asan hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Class: blueprint (attributes aur methods); object: apni values wala instance; __init__ values set karta hai.
Encapsulation: data aur methods aik class mein; public name, protected _name, private __name.
Inheritance: single, multiple, multilevel; overriding aur super().
Polymorphism: compile-time (overloading; Python mein default aur *args se naqal) aur runtime (overriding).
